task: noisy quantized mixed GELU FFN structure recovery

blackBox.visibilityToGcl: oracle calls only: f(vector); true channel count, directions, biases, readout weights, noise seed, and clean target are hidden from the solver
blackBox.oracleNoise: stochastic Gaussian output noise plus finite-precision quantization; solver uses repeated median queries

claimScope.provesIfPasses: GCL can recover explicit mixed GELU atom structure under controlled stochastic noise and quantization, including balanced, near-parallel, and weak-but-resolvable channel profiles; the recovered structure is also prediction-sanity checked against dependency-free, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and sklearn-MLP fit baselines across IID and OOD held-out noiseless truth
claimScope.doesNotClaim: full GPT-2 FFN extraction, arbitrary 3072-channel recovery, arbitrary 4096D/16384D production LLM block decompilation, noisy SwiGLU mixed-block recovery, PyTorch deep baseline superiority, XGBoost/MLP/RF as structure-decompiler competitors, semantic original-neuron identity from output-only access, or broad SOTA status

predictionBaselineScope.purpose: checks that the recovered explicit GELU structure is not merely worse than strong black-box output fitting on held-out truth
predictionBaselineScope.notAClaim: XGBoost, random forests, and sklearn MLP are not structure decompilers and are not treated as direct rivals for recovered channel identity, directions, or canonical atoms
